title: The customer page reads every representative row as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide with the zoom at 100%, and the design picture "customer-15-n2-page-three.png" (board 2.15) attached to this case is open beside it at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows Service Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Service Parts {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: {Customer-A}'s page is open in that browser window.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Compare the representative rows with the picture of board 2.15.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Service Labor", "Sales Representative - Service Parts" and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" with their names as plain text, in the window's order, styled like the page's other rows, as in the picture.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R19, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, boards 2.15 The customer page reads every row (the attached pictures are these boards). Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R19: “The customer page shows the representatives with the window's labels, in the window's order: "Sales Representative" or "Sales Representative - Service Labor", then "Sales Representative - Service Parts" when added, then "Sales Representative - Part Sales" when added. An empty one reads "Unassigned". The Sales Representative rows show on every customer, whether or not the customer has an address. The other fields on the page keep today's rule of showing only when the customer has an address.”
  • Design — board 2.15 title: “2.15 The customer page reads every row”
  • Design — board 2.15 note: “Service Parts added back (Jason Garrison) and saved. The customer page shows the same rows as the window, as plain text: Service Labor Christian Wallace, Service Parts Jason Garrison, Part Sales Dylan Rush.”
